model_output.rationale: All four lines denied OA-18. The 837P bills 97140-GP-KX twice and 97110-GP-KX twice on the same DOS without a distinguishing modifier — payer matched them as duplicates. Chart note confirms two distinct timed 97140 sessions (15 min, 14 min) and two distinct 97110 sessions (31 min, 16 min): legitimate repeat services. False duplicate, not true duplicate. Filing indicator MB → Medicare Part B FFS; frequency 7 not accepted. Remedy is clerical-error reopening to add modifier 76 to the repeat lines (3 and 4).

root_cause.explanation: Lines 3 (97140) and 4 (97110) repeat the same code/DOS as lines 1 and 2 without modifier 76 — payer fired duplicate edit. Chart note confirms two separate timed sessions for each code; this is a false duplicate.

next_action.detail: Medicare Part B: frequency 7 not accepted. Submit a clerical-error reopening to the Novitas MAC. Add modifier 76 to lines 3 and 4 (the second instance of 97140 and 97110). Cite chart note documenting distinct timed sessions. Do not resend as a new original — that fires duplicate again.
